method.unit: One diagnosis = one failed test. MIX-01 has four diagnoses, each scored against the case named in its 'expected' map, so 15 single cases + 4 = 19 diagnoses.
method.category: Correct when failure_category equals actual_category or is in acceptable_categories.
method.root_cause: Judged manually against actual_root_cause: correct = the same mechanism is the main hypothesis; partial = the mechanism is mentioned only as one of several alternatives or a key part is missing; wrong = a different mechanism. For IE cases the reference cause is that the data cannot decide, so correct means the model says so and names the actual cause among the alternatives.
method.evidence: Supported when every quoted line appears in failures.json (whitespace-normalized) and the key_evidence signals are covered. Three lines restate JSON fields of the test case in another format with the same values; they count as supported.
